annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Commission, Directorate-General for Education, Youth, Sport and Culture (Georgian translation published by Education and Research Center with EU Delegation to Georgia)
key_provisions_or_claims: Guiding questions for educators organised around the seven key requirements of Trustworthy AI (ALTAI).
School case scenarios, e.g. adaptive tutoring systems and student data dashboards, with ethical prompts.
Advises schools to plan AI and data use, raise awareness and engage communities.
Recommends developing educators' competences for ethical AI and data use.
Draws on the EU AI Act proposal, GDPR, Data Act proposal and the Declaration on Digital Rights and Principles.
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Georgian-language edition of the European Commission's Ethical Guidelines on the Use of AI and Data in Teaching and Learning for Educators. It gives teachers and school leaders guiding questions based on the Trustworthy AI requirements, with school scenarios and competence-building advice. It is not about robotics.
annotation.title_clean: სწავლა-სწავლების პროცესში ხელოვნური ინტელექტისა (AI) და მონაცემების გამოყენების ეთიკური გზამკვლევი განათლების სპეციალისტებისთვის
annotation.title_en: Ethical Guidelines on the Use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Data in Teaching and Learning for Educators
